_targets: alert_below is set from the cheapest fare actually observed for each destination, so day one is quiet and only a real drop speaks up. Re-measured 2026-08-09 against nonstop-only fares across all 15 upcoming holiday windows, when max_stops went to 0 — the old values were tuned on one-stop fares and would never have fired again (Seoul's was 350 against a cheapest nonstop of 712).
_stops: Nonstop everywhere, matching the dashboard's own default. HGH has no target because it has no nonstop observation to set one from: SIN-HGH fails inside fast-flights (RuntimeError: list index out of range) in every window, at any stop limit, the same parser gap as SIN-PVG and SIN-CTU. NKG hits it too but parsed in 3 of 15 windows, and had a Scoot nonstop in all three.
